Fixing/preventing a reactive dog 👇 When following these steps, make sure to mark and reward them when they make the decision to look away from the distraction and look at you for treats instead!  The most basic training all dogs need to do is to go to crowded places, outside dog parks, etc and practice being calm when there’s lots of stimulation going on! 1. Desensitization For your dog to become less reactive, they need to get used to stimulating environments. For us, Kiwi was reactive to dogs, especially when they bark and run around. So for us, we went outside dog parks and gave a treat every time she would observe calmly! If its too stimulating, then find a less crowded space to where your dog will still pay attention. 2. Distance Chances are when you take your dog outside, they may not pay attention to you. If this is the case, you need to start in an empty area outside to where they will still listen to you and ask for treats. As they get better, slowly move to more and more stimulating environments. 3. Redirection When they do become reactive and stimulated, try your best to redirect their attention. For this, you might want to learn a proper recall trick. Let me know if this is something you want a video for too! Although it seems helpless at first, it really is possible to fix! It might not be easy, the earlier you try and fix it, the more enjoyable your life will be with your dog for the rest of their life.
